price_diff.example_label: Example monthly cost for 10M input tokens and 2M output tokens. Labeled example, not a bill.

api_changes.detail: The Groq API reference says transcriptions are POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/audio/transcriptions. It names whisper-large-v3 and whisper-large-v3-turbo as the model ids currently available. The sample only changes the model field.

code_change.before:
from groq import Groq
client = Groq()
transcription = client.audio.transcriptions.create(
    file=("sample_audio.m4a", open("sample_audio.m4a", "rb").read()),
    model="distil-whisper-large-v3-en",
)
code_change.after:
from groq import Groq
client = Groq()
transcription = client.audio.transcriptions.create(
    file=("sample_audio.m4a", open("sample_audio.m4a", "rb").read()),
    model="whisper-large-v3-turbo",
)
